description: RFC 0016 K5 (R89) core-world smoke test: tools/quality/core_world_smoke.py boots every retail map of Portal (run/runtime) and Portal 2 (the Steam installation) headless with r_core_world 1 and r_core_world_strict at its default 1, and judges the core per map from r_core_world_stats. Maps come from the content; this file only excludes non-playable maps (each with its reason) and records known failures (each with its owner).

known_failures.reason: texture materials/metal/metalwall_bts_001a_normal has no material system handle
known_failures.note: 2026-09-28 at b4773b13: the core claims the cubemap-patched brush material maps/sp_a3_crazy_box/metal/metalwall_bts_001b_1792_-256_-160 and fails its first view: its bump map texture reaches the core without a material system handle. Deterministic; the map loads with r_core_world 0.

known_failures.reason: a slot names no queued view of the current world
known_failures.note: 2026-09-28 at b4773b13: fatal when the process changes level to it from mp_coop_tbeam_polarity (the map before it in the sweep); it passes when loaded first. Reproduced in three sweeps and as the pair alone. WorldPass's slot record found no queued view of the current world (render/pass/world/world_pass.cpp): a slot recorded across the level change under mat_queue_mode 2, as a changelevel would in play.

intermittent_failures.note: 2026-09-28 at b4773b13: one SIGSEGV loading sp_a1_intro1 after mp_coop_wall_intro (a co-op map) with the core on, right after 'Redownloading all lightmaps'; it did not recur in two more sweeps or three runs of the same pair, and the map loads with r_core_world 0. No core dump was retained; the process's engine.log and stdout.log are in the run's evidence. Untriaged: the crash may not be the core's.
